_comment: Client-approved Platinum weekly plan. Mon Legs/Calves/Abs, Tue Back/Biceps/Abs, Wed Rest day: Abs & Cardio only, Thu Chest/Triceps/Abs, Fri Shoulders/Abs. Cardio closes every day (heart rate 120-150). Sat/Sun not specified. Friday abs: sets not specified by client.

exercises.name: Leg Extensions
instructions: Align your knees with the machine axis.
Extend your legs fully without locking, then lower slowly.
formTips: Keep your back against the pad.
warnings: Use a pain-free range only.

exercises.name: Seated Plate-Loaded Leg Press or Barbell Squats
equipment: Plate-loaded leg press or barbell rack
instructions: Place your feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Lower until your knees bend comfortably, then press through mid-foot.
formTips: Keep your lower back on the seat.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
warnings: Do not lock your knees at the top.

exercises.name: Seated or Lying Hamstring Curls
instructions: Align your knees with the machine axis.
Curl your heels toward you, then return slowly.
warnings: Stop if you feel a cramp or sharp pain.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlifts — Barbell or Dumbbells
instructions: Stand tall holding the weight in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back, lower to mid-shin, then stand up.
formTips: Keep the weight close to your legs.
warnings: Stop if your back rounds. Use a lighter weight.

exercises.name: Adductor Machine
instructions: Sit upright with your back on the pad.
Bring your legs together with control, then open slowly.
warnings: Use a comfortable range of motion.

exercises.name: Abductor Machine
instructions: Sit upright with your back on the pad.
Push your legs outward with control, then return slowly.
warnings: Use a comfortable range of motion.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raises
instructions: Sit with your knees under the pad.
Raise your heels, pause, then lower slowly.
formTips: Feel the stretch at the bottom.
warnings: Reduce the load if you feel Achilles pain.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raises
instructions: Stand tall with the balls of your feet on the platform.
Rise onto your toes, pause, then lower slowly.
formTips: Use the full range of motion.
warnings: Hold a support if you feel unsteady.

exercises.name: Abdominal Crunch Machine — Light Weight
instructions: Adjust the seat and hold the handles with a light weight.
Exhale as you crunch forward, then return slowly.
formTips: Do not pull with your arms.
warnings: Stop if you feel lower-back strain.

exercises.name: Leg Raises on Decline Bench
instructions: Lie on the decline bench and hold the top handles.
Raise your legs with control, then lower slowly.
warnings: Bend your knees if your lower back arches.

exercises.name: Cardio — Bike, Treadmill or Elliptical
instructions: Warm up for 3-5 minutes, then settle into a steady pace.
Stay at a pace you can keep for 30 to 60 minutes.
formTips: Keep your heart rate around 120-150 bpm.
warnings: Stop if you feel dizzy or have chest pain.

exercises.name: Seated Lat Pulldowns on Cable Machine
instructions: Sit with your thighs secured under the pads.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, then return slowly.
warnings: Stop if you feel sharp shoulder pain.

exercises.name: Seated Close-Grip Pulldowns on Cable Machine
instructions: Sit tall and hold the close-grip handle.
Pull down to your chest, squeeze, then return with control.
warnings: Use a weight you can control.

exercises.name: Standing Barbell or Dumbbell Back Rows
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back and the weight hanging.
Row to your lower ribs, squeeze, then lower slowly.
warnings: Do not round your lower back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Pullovers on Bench
instructions: Lie across the bench holding one dumbbell over your chest.
Lower it back behind your head with straight-ish arms, then pull back up.
warnings: Use a lighter weight if your shoulders feel strained.

exercises.name: Lower Back Extensions — Machine or Freestanding
instructions: Set the pad at hip level and cross your arms.
Lower with control, then extend to a straight line. Do not over-arch.
warnings: Stop if you feel pinching or pain in the lower back.

exercises.name: Standing Dumbbell or Barbell Curls
instructions: Stand tall with elbows at your sides.
Curl up and lower with control.
warnings: Reduce the weight if your elbows drift forward.

exercises.name: Preacher Curls on Bench — Barbell or Dumbbell
instructions: Rest your upper arms on the pad.
Curl up, then lower slowly to almost full extension.
formTips: Keep your upper arms on the pad.
warnings: Do not fully lock the elbows at the bottom.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Concentration Curls on Bench
instructions: Sit on the bench and brace your elbow against your inner thigh.
Curl the dumbbell up, squeeze, then lower slowly.
warnings: Do not swing the weight.

exercises.name: Lying Ab Crunches
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Exhale as you curl up, then lower with control.
formTips: Do not pull on your neck.
warnings: Stop if you feel lower-back strain.

exercises.name: Standing Apparatus Leg Raises
instructions: Support yourself on the apparatus with your back against the pad.
Raise your legs with control, then lower slowly.
warnings: Bend your knees if your lower back arches.

exercises.name: Cardio — Bike, Treadmill or Elliptical
instructions: Warm up for 3-5 minutes, then settle into a steady pace.
Stay at a pace you can keep for 30 to 60 minutes.
formTips: Keep your heart rate around 120-150 bpm.
warnings: Stop if you feel dizzy or have chest pain.

exercises.name: Ab Crunch Machine — Light Weight
instructions: Adjust the seat and hold the handles with a light weight.
Exhale as you crunch forward, then return slowly.
formTips: Do not pull with your arms.
warnings: Stop if you feel lower-back strain.

exercises.name: Decline Bench Leg Raises
instructions: Lie on the decline bench and hold the top handles.
Raise your legs with control, then lower slowly.
warnings: Bend your knees if your lower back arches.

exercises.name: Cardio — Bike, Treadmill or Elliptical
instructions: Warm up for 3-5 minutes, then settle into a steady pace.
Aim for 1 hour at a pace you can sustain.
formTips: Keep your heart rate around 120-150 bpm.
warnings: Stop if you feel dizzy or have chest pain.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press — Barbell or Dumbbell
instructions: Set the bench to a moderate incline and press from upper chest.
Lower with control, then press up without locking the elbows.
warnings: Use a spotter or a weight you can control.

exercises.name: Bench Press — Barbell or Dumbbell
instructions: Lie flat with your feet planted and press from mid-chest.
Lower with control, then press up without locking the elbows.
warnings: Use a spotter or a weight you can control.

exercises.name: Machine Bench Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with mid-chest.
Press forward without locking the elbows, then return slowly.
warnings: Stop if you feel shoulder pinching.

exercises.name: Cable Crossovers or Pec Deck Flyes
instructions: Set the handles at about shoulder height and step forward.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest, then open with control.
formTips: Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
warnings: Use a comfortable stretch only.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Flyes
instructions: Lie on the incline bench with dumbbells above your chest.
Open your arms in a wide arc with soft elbows, then bring them back together.
warnings: Do not go lower than a comfortable stretch.

exercises.name: Standing Cable Pushdowns
instructions: Pin your elbows at your sides.
Press down until your arms are straight, then return with control.
formTips: Squeeze your triceps at the bottom.
warnings: Do not lock the elbows aggressively.

exercises.name: Seated Overhead Tricep Extensions with EZ Bar
instructions: Hold the EZ bar overhead with both hands.
Lower it behind your head by bending the elbows, then extend.
warnings: Choose a lighter weight if your elbows hurt.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Overhead Extensions
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead.
Lower it behind your head by bending the elbow, then extend.
formTips: Keep your upper arm close to your head.
Complete all reps, then switch arms.
warnings: Choose a lighter dumbbell if your elbow hurts.

exercises.name: Abdominal Crunch Machine — Light Weight
instructions: Adjust the seat and hold the handles with a light weight.
Exhale as you crunch forward, then return slowly.
formTips: Do not pull with your arms.
warnings: Stop if you feel lower-back strain.

exercises.name: Leg Raises on Decline Bench
instructions: Lie on the decline bench and hold the top handles.
Raise your legs with control, then lower slowly.
warnings: Bend your knees if your lower back arches.

exercises.name: Cardio — Bike, Treadmill or Elliptical
instructions: Warm up for 3-5 minutes, then settle into a steady pace.
Stay at a pace you can keep for 30 to 60 minutes.
formTips: Keep your heart rate around 120-150 bpm.
warnings: Stop if you feel dizzy or have chest pain.

exercises.name: Seated Shoulder Press — Dumbbell or Barbell
instructions: Sit with your back supported and the weight at shoulder height.
Press overhead without arching your back, then lower with control.
warnings: Skip if you have acute shoulder pain.

exercises.name: Standing Dumbbell Lateral Raises
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise your arms out to shoulder height, then lower slowly.
warnings: Do not raise above shoulder height.

exercises.name: Standing Upright Rows with Barbell
instructions: Hold the bar in front of your thighs with a shoulder-width grip.
Lift it toward your chest with elbows high, then lower slowly.
formTips: Keep the bar close to your body.
warnings: Stop if you feel shoulder pinching.

exercises.name: Seated Rear Shoulder Dumbbell Raises
instructions: Sit and lean forward with a dumbbell in each hand.
Raise your arms out to the sides, squeeze, then lower slowly.
formTips: Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
warnings: Do not swing your torso.

exercises.name: Lying Ab Crunches
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Exhale as you curl up, then lower with control.
formTips: Do not pull on your neck.
warnings: Stop if you feel lower-back strain.

exercises.name: Standing Apparatus Machine Leg Raises
instructions: Support yourself on the apparatus with your back against the pad.
Raise your legs with control, then lower slowly.
warnings: Bend your knees if your lower back arches.

Stay at a pace you can keep for 30 to 60 minutes.
formTips: Keep your heart rate around 120-150 bpm.
warnings: Stop if you feel dizzy or have chest pain.
